body:
CURRENT ENGRAM RUN RULE (Engram::Fable; rev 15, 2026-11-06 17:37Z, which updates item 4 to the 44ae62c6 pins; history is in revisions 1-14).
SOURCE: GREG DIRECT via Engram::Advisor #2499 (2026-10-31 22:46Z), verbatim: "Greg sugeruje podzial pracy: Windows A do kodowania zmian i przygotowania paczek; test runy na pozostalych maszynach remote. Prosze organizowac wszystkie mozliwe focused i full runs na DL560/Mac/Windows B przez natywne sesje i mailbox, Windows B dla testow zależnych od Windows. Central tylko gdy istnieje konkretna techniczna potrzeba. Nie dokladac recznych procedur; podajcie realne uruchomienia i usuncie sztuczne ograniczenia." Also Greg 2026-11-06: remote tests run only through registered project sessions on that host (memory rules-greg-remote-tests-via-project-sessions-2026-11-06).
1. Windows A (Central) is for coding and packaging. Cargo runs there only for a named concrete need, under Termal::Opus2's named Central GO, one Cargo job at a time.
2. Jobs go directly from an Engram coder or merger to a runner by native mail: a git bundle of the exact commit (its prerequisite must be a commit the runner holds), the tree and the exact argv. The runner's census is the admission rule for FOCUSED jobs. Every FULL on DL560 needs Opus2's named slot GO; there is ONE shared DL560 FULL queue for both projects (agreed with Fable2 #6696/#6697, 2026-11-06). Each job gets one fresh worktree and target. Unchanged input is not retried without a concrete reason. A never-started job is withdrawn and confirmed "withdrawn, not started" before it is resent. Runners have no tracker route; owners record ENDs and gates.
3. RUNNERS:
- DL560 (host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1): Engram jobs go ONLY via session-4 (Central mirror 15580, project "DL560 · Engram runner", root /home/greg/github/Engram-runner). It is deliberately NOT connected to an Engram store and writes via domain mailbox 4369f879. Session-1 "Codex Live" serves TermAl only; it belongs to the TermAl project, so Engram registrations there were refused with 400. Census: MemAvailable ≥64 GiB; disk ≥60 GB plus footprint; load <64, with a numeric reading before every command; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS 48.
- Windows B (host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9, relay mailbox): Windows-dependent tests and full gates. At most 1 full or 2 focused jobs; ≥25 GiB free commit. Its dispatch helper must use exact argv arrays: a PowerShell .Replace once broadened a focused run, and request 161 was interrupted.
- Mac 6201 (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201, clone /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner): the ordinary Unix lane, FIFO, ≥60 GB free after the footprint.
4. SOURCE-OWNER BINARY for the launcher's `engram source` adapter. Default: $CARGO_HOME/bin/engram, else ~/.cargo/bin/engram. Override per process with an absolute ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY. No PATH lookup and no autobuild; a missing binary means unavailable, never plain. Per lane:
- Central: the installed C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe (44ae62c6, build_fingerprint 3a053d4e…, installed 17:19Z 2026-11-06).
- DL560: the installed /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram, still 2d03fd4e (installed 13:00Z 2026-11-06). Refreshing it to 44ae needs an explicit, recorded install under Greg's DL560 approval (memory rules-greg-dl560-engram-install-2026-11-06).
- Windows B: NO installed engram. Pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY=C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner\target\pinned\engram-44ae62c62f225f4dc47378ddeee1a662282b875d.exe (SHA256 1b91fd60…d4ac, pinned 17:27Z 2026-11-06). The old 2d03 pin is retained.
- Mac: NO installed engram. Pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY=/Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner/target/pinned/engram-source-44ae62c62f225f4dc47378ddeee1a662282b875d (SHA256 94da572e…9ebd, pinned 17:31Z 2026-11-06). The old 2d03 pin is retained.
Never install outside the repo without Greg's word. Refresh the pins after a landing that changes reader semantics, explicitly and on the record. Tests always point at the candidate's own build, never at the pin.
5. STANDING RUNNER CLEANUP: when the census refuses an Engram job for lack of space, the runner may delete the Cargo build output under its own finished jobs' target/, oldest first and only as much as needed. Use checked absolute paths inside the clone, with no symlinks leading out. KEEP worktrees, target/tmp and home, inputs, review-runs, logs, fixtures and target/pinned. Never touch an active job or a protected TermAl lane. Log each deletion in .logs/ and report it in the next END.
